purpose: Teach: 議長/座長/委任/定額/賃貸/図面/法制/県知事

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 委員会の、本気で、絶対、議長、絶対、警察、絶対、ご報告、絶対、申し上げます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The committee chairperson — we'll file a police report. We're genuinely grateful for your cooperation.
lines.style: Formal, measured cadence. Official register but not cold. Each phrase lands with deliberate weight. Slight pause between statements, like reading from prepared remarks. Respectful without stiffness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。座長、本気で、絶対、お引き受け、絶対、警察様、絶対、ありがとうございます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We accept the position. Thank you to the police department. We're genuinely grateful.
lines.style: Cooperative but grounded. Steady pace, no rush. The tone of someone confirming understanding and commitment in equal measure. Respectful nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、委任、絶対、状、絶対、頂戴したいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: For this matter, we'd like to receive a formal proxy letter from the police department.
lines.style: Professional, procedural. Each word precise. No inflection toward urgency or hesitation — this is standard protocol. Clear, direct, as though reading from protocol guidelines.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様の、本気で、絶対、定額、絶対、賠償、絶対、ご提案、絶対、確認いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've confirmed receipt of the police department's proposed compensation amount.
lines.style: Businesslike confirmation. Steady, efficient delivery. The tone of someone checking items off a list — accurate without being mechanical. Brief and complete.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、賃貸、絶対、物件、絶対、関連の、絶対、通報、絶対、増えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're seeing an increase in reports related to rental properties coming through the police department.
lines.style: Informational, matter-of-fact. Slight weight on 'increase' — the data point being shared. Measured pace. No alarm, but the note is being raised for a reason.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。建物の、本気で、絶対、図面、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご提出、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've submitted the building blueprints to the police department.
lines.style: Confirmation of action taken. Steady, professional tone. The satisfaction of a task completed and communicated. No hesitation, no embellishment.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、法制、絶対、改正、絶対、対応、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police department is advancing efforts to respond to legislative reform on this front.
lines.style: Official update. Slightly formal register — this is information of substance. Deliberate pacing. The tone of someone sharing progress in an ongoing process that matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。県知事、本気で、絶対、表敬訪問、絶対、警察様、絶対、護衛、絶対、お願いします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We'd like to request police escort for the prefectural governor's courtesy visit.
lines.style: Formal request, final item. Polite but direct. The tone of concluding a meeting with one remaining procedural ask. Professional gratitude underlying the request.
